issues.description: The type of the Person.firstName field is inconsistent between template and solution. In the template Person.java the field is declared as String (private String firstName;), and all tests and the rest of the code expect String (setFirstName("Max")). In the solution Person.java the field is erroneously declared as int (private int firstName;), while getters/setters and usages treat it as String. This mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from running or using the provided solution/tests as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the declaration of firstName in the solution's Person.java to match the template and tests: use 'private String firstName;' and ensure the getter/setter types are String. This will align the solution file with the template, tests, and intended problem specification.
